name: S3 Ransomware and Object Tampering
description: S3 ransomware is not one API. Attackers turn off versioning so old copies cannot be restored, shorten lifecycle so objects expire, overwrite files, or encrypt them with a key only they hold. Users then see missing or unreadable files. The account still exists; the data is held hostage. Versioning-off plus bulk deletes or SSE-C overwrites from an unusual role is the pattern to catch early.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
